filter.description: Filter expression used to {link Persistable#fetch} the objects that start the recursion.

limit.description:
The maximum number of Source Objs used to start the recursion. If there are fewer rows than were requested, only those will be returned.
If there are additional rows beyond what was requested, then {@link RecursiveFetchSpec.hasMore} will be set to true.

Due to the large amount of data that is fetched per Source Obj, the default is to return
results for 1 Source Obj. 15 Source Objs is the maximum.

maxDepth.description: The maximum depth of the recursion. A depth of 10 is used as default, you may choose a shallower depth but due to the potential to collect large amounts of data, the maximum depth is 10.

excludedPaths.description:
The opposite of {@link approvedPaths}

Specifies the data model paths that you want to avoid during recursion. This is useful for
preventing recursion from going down a path that contains large quantities of low value data.
The format of the paths should include the Source Type, eg:

If your Source Type was ServicePoint and you wanted to avoid fetching Measurement data
on a specific path,
["ServicePoint.measurementSeries.data"]

If your Source Type was ServicePoint and you wanted to avoid fetching Measurement AND
MeterOutage data on a specific path,
["ServicePoint.measurementSeries.data", "ServicePoint.meterMappings.toElectricMetertAsset.meterOutages"]

excludedTypes.description:
Specifies the types that you want to avoid during recursion. Only the exact type specified
will be excluded, any type that extends the excluded type is considered valid.  This is
useful if you dont want categorically stop recursion when a certain type is encountered.

If you wanted to avoid fetching Measurement data,
["Measurement"]

If you wanted to avoid fetching MeterOutage AND Measurement data,
["MeterOutage", "Measurement"]

approvedPaths.description:
The opposite of {@link excludedPaths}

Specifies the data model paths that you want to use during recursion. This is useful if
you only want recursion to occur down a few specific paths. The format of the paths should
include the Source Type, eg:

If your Source Type was ServicePoint and you wanted to ONLY fetch data that is related to
the 'activeMeter' of the ServicePoint
["ServicePoint.activeMeter"]

If your Source Type was ServicePoint and you wanted to ONLY fetch data that is related to
the 'activeMeter' OR 'services'
MeterOutage data on a specific path,
["ServicePoint.activeMeter", "ServicePoint.services"]

anonymizePII.description: If true, the fetched data will be scrubbed for personally identifiable information (PII). By default this feature is disabled.

title: Specification of what Objs to fetch related data in a {@link Persistable#recursiveFetch} call.
name: RecursiveFetchSpec
